clues.narrowing: Rules out inland and hill towns; puts the player on a flat canal city by the sea in west Europe.

source.quote: Amsterdam was founded at the mouth of the Amstel river, which was dammed to control flooding.

clues.text: This flat city sits where a river meets the sea in the west of Europe. Rings of still canals cross its streets like slow roads of water.

clues.narrowing: Rules out deep-freeze inland towns; keeps mild sea-air towns where frost needs a mainland wind.

source.quote: Frosts mainly occur during spells of easterly or northeasterly winds from the inner European continent.

clues.text: Frost comes here only when cold winds blow in from the deep mainland. Most nights stay mild, since close sea air and town heat soften the chill.

clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to the one city the rule book first named capital by that word in 1983.

source.quote: Since the 1983 constitutional revision, the constitution mentions "Amsterdam" and "capital" in chapter 2, article 32

clues.text: In 1983 the land's rule book first called this city the capital by that word. New kings still take their oath and crown here.

clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: rings of canals plus streets ruled by bikes point to one city.

source.quote: Cycling is key to the city's modern character, and there are numerous biking paths and lanes spread throughout.

clues.text: Rings of canals loop through this city, and bikes rule its streets. Folks pedal past rows of tall thin houses that line each canal.

clues.narrowing: Confirms it: kings are crowned here, while the government and top court work in The Hague.

source.quote: The main governmental institutions, and foreign embassies, are located in The Hague.

clues.text: Kings take their crown in this city, in a church by its royal palace. The government and top court do their daily work in The Hague.

reveal.blurb: Fishers built a small town by a dam on a river, and trade ships later made it rich and famous. Its canals and grand houses still show that golden age, and bikes fill its streets today. Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands.
